Engine 1

Schema Validation

Your data has a contract. Veritas enforces it. Field completeness, type mismatches, constraint violations, schema drift — every deviation is caught before it reaches production.

Schema Audit — Customer Revenue Pipeline

Expected Fields 42
Present Fields 42 / 42
Type Mismatches 3 detected
Constraint Violations 1 — negative revenue in Q3
Breaking Changes None
Drift Status Minor — 2 new columns added upstream
Engine 2

Data Quality

Completeness. Accuracy. Freshness. Consistency. These aren't aspirations — they're measurable dimensions. Veritas scores each one, identifies the gaps, and tells you exactly where to fix.

Quality Dimensions — E-Commerce Customer Data

Completeness 94.2%
Accuracy 78.6%
Duplicate Rate 12.4% — 31,000 records
Freshness vs SLA 3.2 hours behind (SLA: 1h)
Null Rate 5.8% — email field
Consistency Score 82.1%
Engine 3

Anomaly Detection

When volume drops forty-seven percent overnight, when distributions shift two standard deviations, when latency spikes from five minutes to two hours — Veritas sees it. Statistical process control meets real-time alerting.

Anomaly Alert — Fraud Detection Feed

Volume Today vs Baseline 12,400 vs 23,500 (-47.2%)
Z-Score -3.41 (critical)
Distribution Shift +2.1 std deviations
Latency Spike 5 min → 2 hrs 14 min
Data Loss Detected 8.3% of records missing
Engine 4

Pipeline Integrity

A pipeline that fails silently is worse than one that fails loudly. Veritas tracks success rates, data loss, mean time to recovery, uptime, and end-to-end lineage. If a record goes missing, you'll know exactly where.

Pipeline Health — Stripe Revenue Analytics

Success Rate 99.7%
Data Loss 0.01%
MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery) 4 min 12 sec
Uptime (30-day) 99.94%
Consecutive Failures 0
End-to-End Lineage Verified — 6 stages traced
